description_full: CD Projekt Red S.A., together its subsidiaries, engages in the production, publishing, and digital distribution of video games and related products in Poland. The company's flagship products include The Witcher series of games and Cyberpunk 2077. It also exports its products to Europe, North America, South America, Asia, Australia, and Africa. The company was formerly known as CD Projekt S.A. and changed its name to CD Projekt Red S.A. in August 2026. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

CEO compensation is 33× revenue per employee (elevated relative to workforce productivity). R&D investment of 4% of revenue (limited) signals commitment to product development and talent.
financial_summary: CD Projekt Red S.A. is a mid-cap communication services business with a $6.7B market cap on $220M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +3% over the past three years, which puts it in mature, slow-growth territory. Operating margins are expanding by +3.8pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.
Returns on capital run at 28% against a 10% cost of capital — a 18-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat. Gross margins of 80% confirm genuine pricing power.
The company is burning through $6M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Shareholder yield is only 0.5%, a thin return of capital, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome, and within its sector the business captures 2.6× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
